Discover new stories, adventures, challenges, and rewards with The Elder Scrolls Online Season One, Return of the Thieves Guild. Prepare to pilfer Glenumbra as part of a new Thieves Guild storyline, take a vacation with Sheogorath, the God of Madness himself, plunder the ocean’s depth during the High Seas of Tamriel event, unlock seasonal rewards via a new Tamriel Tome, and more. The Elder Scrolls Online Season One is now live from July 8 until October 21 and is free for all ESO players—see you in Tamriel!

text:
Apex Legends - Cyberpunk Event Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
Welcome to the Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event, where the neon lights of E-District beckon in Wildcard and Cyberware floods the streets. But be careful: reports of Cyberpsychosis are on the rise. Hunt down the Mythic Skippy Alternator and Iconic Legend skins, and earn Eddies throughout the event to spend in the Reward Shop.

The Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event goes live July 14.

Apex Legends™ is a free-to-play* battle royale game where legendary characters battle for glory, fame, and fortune on the fringes of the Frontier. Play for free now on PlayStation® 4, PlayStation 5.

Credits:
Production company: Electronic Arts & Dark Burn Creative
Sound design and mix: Respawn Entertainment & Mass Audio
All other categories: Electronic Arts & Respawn Entertainment

*Applicable platform account and platform subscription (sold separately) may be required. Persistent internet connection and EA Account required. Age restrictions apply. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

Fangtopia - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018955/

Fangtopia is coming to PS5 this spooky season! A cosy tile-placement puzzler game where you grow a haunted world by connecting terrain, landmarks and monster habitats. Match tiles, place landmarks, discover monsters with no time pressures. Meet werewolves, yetis, scarecrows and more while taking on your friends to unlock over 40 unique landmarks. Multiple modes to match your vibes, compete with friends to top the leaderboard for the crown of Fangtopia.
